answer_1.quote: We focus on three tasks ... pun recognition, pun explanation, and pun generation.
answer_1.outputs: pun texts (recognition labels, natural language explanations, generated pun sentences)

answer_2.quote: We introduce an Overlap metric to measure the originality of the puns generated by LLMs. ... metrics consist of Ambiguity, Distinctiveness, Surprise, and One-pun-word Incorporation Rate.

answer_3.quote: We instruct ... to choose the winner between the human explanation and the model explanation (allowing for a tie).

answer_4.quote: We ask our annotators to identify whether a pun text is successful and rate its funniness on a scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: identify whether a pun text is successful and rate its funniness on a scale from 1 to 5
